entries.desc: Smoke creates a story in INIT, simulates a concurrent git clean -fd on the shared checkout, and on current main asserts the metadata files are gone (reproduces the bug)

evidence.note: init-window-data-loss smoke drives the real story_create then a concurrent git clean -fd; asserts the INIT metadata survives (would be RED without the fix, proven by scratch neutralization).

entries.desc: Smoke covers both the allowlisted-not-ignored leaf (.lattice/story/actives/**) and an ignored leaf, since clean -fd vs clean -fdx differ

evidence.note: Smoke covers the allowlisted-not-ignored actives leaf (survives clean -fd once tracked) AND an ignored runtime leaf (removed by clean -fdx), proving allowlist+tracking is what saves it.

entries.desc: Smoke asserts actual metadata file bytes present/absent (not just an exit code), so a no-op fix cannot make it falsely pass

evidence.note: All assertions read actual file bytes (existsSync + byte-identity readFileSync), never exit codes, so a no-op fix cannot fake a pass.

entries.desc: story_create commits the INIT metadata to main HEAD; git ls-files shows the leaf tracked immediately after create

evidence.note: After real story_create the smoke asserts the leaf is tracked in HEAD (git ls-files / committed safe-init 'lattice: story <id> init'); validated green.

entries.desc: INIT_CHECK bootstrap is idempotent when main already carries the metadata (no duplicate/empty commit, no hard-fail); story_discard --purge still reverses via purgeSafeInitCommit or tombstone fallback

evidence.note: review-pass-discard assertPurgeDropsSafeInitCommit still passes (discard reverses safe-init via HEAD~1; tombstone fallback when buried); INIT_CHECK bootstrap idempotent (before=1 after=1 init commit) per CHK-002 transcript.

entries.desc: A concurrent git clean -fd and a wrong-branch checkout on the shared checkout cannot wipe the now-tracked metadata; the safe-init commit is inside the main-write-lock so it serializes against a concurrent DONE merge

evidence.note: Concurrent git clean -fd / -fdx cannot wipe the now-tracked metadata (smoke); safe-init commit registered as cross-function main-write-locked in main-write-lock-coverage, serializing against concurrent DONE merge.

entries.desc: evaluateStoryMetadataProtection flags unsafe=true for the !ignored && !tracked (allowlisted-but-uncommitted) state

evidence.note: predicate: tracked leaf (either ignore state) -> unsafe=false (safe); committed-leaf bootstrap+doctor cases assert no false positive. Covers the happy path that a correctly committed metadata leaf is never flagged.

entries.desc: Still flags the original ignored && !tracked case; a tracked leaf remains safe (unsafe=false) regardless of ignore state

evidence.note: edge: the new INIT-window case !ignored && !tracked (allowlisted-but-uncommitted leaf) -> unsafe=true. Covered by predicate unit, bootstrap dev_start DATA-LOSS warning, and doctor scan INIT-window risk line + unsafeLeaves(ignored=false,tracked=false).

entries.desc: Blank/whitespace leaf path is rejected (throws), so no consumer can classify an empty path as safe; doctor surfaces the new case without false-positiving a correctly committed leaf

evidence.note: adversarial: a blank/whitespace leaf throws at the consumer (runtime re-validation, never silently safe); ignored && !tracked stays unsafe (ClawCreek); and installing the allowlist via doctor --repair alone does NOT make an uncommitted leaf safe (still unsafe until committed). All asserted in the protection smoke.
